bio: Robert Bruce Charles (born August 23, 1960) is an American lawyer. He served as the Assistant Secretary of State for International Narcotics and Law Enforcement Affairs from 2003 to 2005. He was the Republican Party nominee for governor of Maine in the 2026 election, where supported increased presence of United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) in Maine.
